goal: Write a formal design specification for solid non-overlapping canvas blocks, continuous collision and edge sliding, soft snapping, deterministic collision-safe ingest placement, clear selection glow and a low-saturation warm-white default text-block background in zeroxB.
non_goals: Do not implement or modify runtime behavior in this task.
Do not introduce parent-child nesting or automatic embedding between content blocks.
Do not make relation lines, freehand strokes or group backgrounds participate as solid collision obstacles.
Do not automatically move, resize or rewrite overlapping nodes in existing canvas documents.
Do not add a persistent collision information panel.
Do not expose or modify the configured localhost AI credential.
acceptance_criteria: The specification defines the exact solid entity set and excludes nesting.
The specification defines a 6 screen-pixel safety gap, 8 screen-pixel snap-entry threshold and 14 screen-pixel snap-break threshold using one operation viewport snapshot.
The specification defines invalid draw and resize previews, release behavior, continuous swept collision and axis sliding without tunneling.
The specification defines rigid multi-selection collision against external entities while preserving internal gaps.
The specification preserves old overlaps and only allows user operations that reduce conflict until separation.
The specification defines deterministic nearest-free placement and vertical batch layout for paste, drop and picker creation.
The specification defines blue-cyan selection glow, red invalid preview, amber legacy conflict and a #F2F1ED default text-block background.
The document contains no placeholders, contradictions or implementation-blocking ambiguity and is committed for user review.
context_sources: src/app/core/main/canvas/canvas-editor.tsx owns creation, selection, move, resize, ingest placement, grouping and history transactions.
src/app/core/main/canvas/nodes/canvas-nodes.tsx renders text blocks, content cards, selection state and node resizers.
src/lib/canvas/gesture-policy.ts owns pure drawing and selection geometry helpers.
src/lib/canvas/content-ingest.ts defines pasted and dropped content drafts and batch ordering.
src/types/canvas.ts defines persisted node style and z-index data.
docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-25-viewport-normalized-content-scaling-design.md defines operation viewport snapshots and screen-to-canvas conversion.
notes: Use the fixed UTF-8 I/O baseline.
The user explicitly rejected block nesting and automatic embedding.
All card-like content nodes are solid entities; relations, freehand and group backgrounds are not.
Draw and resize may break through soft snap and show a red invalid preview, but invalid release never commits overlap.
Stop after writing, independently reviewing and committing the specification so the user can review it before implementation planning.
